title: aker bp starts production skarv satellite fields 2026 08 26
text:
Aug 26 (Reuters) - Norway's Aker BP (AKRBP.OL)
, opens new tab
 said on Wednesday it had started ​oil and gas production ‌from its Skarv Satellite Project, which comprises the Alve Nord, Idun ​Nord and Oern fields ​in the Norwegian Sea.
